original_description:
### Rose Petals (Gulab Patti) – 60g | Pure, Natural Dried Petals for Culinary & Aromatic Use

Immerse yourself in the quiet grace of Rose Petals (Gulab Patti) — carefully hand-harvested and gently air-dried to retain their natural form, soft texture, and delicate fragrance. These pure dried petals are free from additives, preservatives, or artificial processing — a simple gift from nature, preserved as it has been for generations.

Traditionally cherished in kitchens and homes, our Gulab Patti adds a touch of floral beauty to teas, desserts, syrups, and sweet delicacies. Their vibrant hue and subtle aroma make them a beloved choice for garnishing, infusing, and enhancing the sensory experience of everyday rituals.

Beyond the plate, dried rose petals are often used in aromatic practices — whether scattered in bathwater, placed in sachets, or offered in moments of quiet reflection. Their presence brings a sense of calm and natural elegance to the home.

#### Time-Honored Uses in Culinary & Aromatic Traditions
For centuries, Gulab Patti has been a gentle companion in culinary artistry and mindful living. Use these rose petals to elevate the visual and olfactory dimension of your meals, beverages, and self-care moments — honoring tradition with every petal.

#### Why Our Rose Petals?
- 100% Pure & Natural — No chemicals, no dyes, no additives
- Hand-Selected & Air-Dried — To preserve color, fragrance, and integrity
- Versatile for Culinary & Aromatic Use — Ideal for teas, desserts, infusions, and rituals
- Resealable Pouch Packaging — Keeps petals fresh and fragrant
- 60g of Premium Quality Gulab Patti — Sufficient for regular home use

Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use as desired in your recipes, rituals, or creative expressions.

Let the quiet beauty of Rose Petals inspire your daily moments — rooted in tradition, untouched by excess.
